maps.title: The Blighted Farm
maps.subtitle: Purple blight
maps.description: A farm veiled in thin mist. Purple mold touches wood, stone, and crops. For years, no troops sent here have returned.
playtest: Approach through the southern farm gate.
Investigate the four buildings and lift their roofs as the party enters.
Follow the path behind the barn to its exterior cellar entrance.
Adjust the lighting, and let the DM’s storyline explain what the party finds.
